title: Har129Requirements
description: The single source of truth for the HAR-129 confirmation matrix (HAR-129 section I). Every requirement that can appear as a visible/product behavior of the final demo is listed once, with a faithful quote from HAR-129 and the required behavior restated. The proof harness derives one matrix row per item here; no row is added by hand and no item may be omitted. New HAR-129 requirements become new entries.

quoted_from.description: Where the quotes come from, so a reviewer can re-read the source.

sections.description: The HAR-129 sections the requirements are grouped under.

requirements.description: One item per HAR-129 visible/product requirement. Ids are unique and the matrix row set must equal this set.

id.description: Stable matrix row id, e.g. HAR129-G-01. Never reused for a different requirement.

section.description: The sections[].id this requirement belongs to.

reference.description: The exact HAR-129 locator, e.g. 'HAR-129 §G' or 'HAR-129 §16 step 7'.

requirement.description: The requirement quoted faithfully from HAR-129. This comes from the contract, not from the implementation.

required_behavior.description: What must be observed live for this requirement to be CONFIRMED.
